items.title: George Guesnon Interview, 1965-09
items.q: See, I got John Handy on alto.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I mean they come so far across the sea and everything, you know. Yeah. Oh, Sammy Remington was sitting right next here. Clarinet player, you know him? Yes, she is. Yeah, and oh man, so many others, man. Yeah, man, I had everybody from England. I got plenty of friends over there. Mm-hmm. Oh, under different conditions, like I said, I gotta go. I just can't run. I just can't run no more. But, uh. Well, as I say, you should have a permanent job, I mean, in England, one, just one place, not running around…

I go to preservation hall and settle on fire every time we go out there. Yeah? See, I got John Handy on alto. Yeah. I had Joe Jackson on piano. He's a great piano player. Come from the Johnny's home, past Chris Van. Past Chris Van.
never done him nothing, but he should play more vampy. Yeah.
